We have had the pleasure of working alongside EMT Services at a number of events, and they are always a pleasure to work with.

Their team is professional, reliable and approachable, providing both security and medical cover to a consistently high standard. They work seamlessly with event organisers and other suppliers, helping events run safely and efficiently while remaining calm and helpful throughout.

It is reassuring to know that EMT Services are on site, and we would have no hesitation in recommending them to anyone looking for a dependable and professional event services provider.
Very professional and quick response to any issues that arrived highly recommended
Excellent service! Contacted about help with an event and the team were so professional, thouroughly discussed our options and did exactly what was needed. Fantastic!

Had the absolute pleasure of working alongside Andy and his team at inter the wild festival.  Absolute legend,  knowledgeable,  professional and a joy to work alongside.
Look forward to working with Emt anytime
